content: सावन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [सवनं यागाङ्गं स्नानं सोमनिष्पीडनं वा तस्येदमण्] Relating to, or comprising, the three {%savanas%}. .{@-नः@} .²1 An institutor of a sacrifice, or one who employs priests at a sacrifice. .²2 The conclusion of a sacrifice, or the ceremony by which it is concluded. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Varuṇa. .²4 A month of thirty solar days. .²5 A natural day from sunrise to sunset. .²6 A particular kind of year. .²7 The Solar year; विचाली हि संवत्सरशब्दः सावनोऽपि गणितदिवसकः <ab>etc.</ab> <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 7. 39</ls>. .{@-नम्@} The correct solar time.
